items.q: But they had this boundary line. And then, at that time, they had a business agent by the name of Jaborotsky in 10. Great, big guy, boy, and he was rough.

ctx.x: Kelly's Stables had them for years. They had Johnny Dodds and Baby Dodds, and those people over there. But, I mean, they were just a few jobs, I mean, nothing like -- I'm talking about the hotels and no radio stations or nothing like that. And no regular bigtime jobs. Kelly's Stables considered a cabaret, a midnight, and that type of a thing, they let them do that.

But they had this boundary line. And then, at that time, they had a business agent by the name of Jaborotsky in 10. Great, big guy, boy, and he was rough. And he would come and he would go and threaten the proprietors and all of that type of a thing, get them out of here, and if I catch them in here, and he was liable to punch the musicians.
